MBE 考点解析
Article III Jurisdiction

正确答案：B 该条款违宪，因为它违反了宪法第三条（Article III）关于美国最高法院（SCOTUS）初始管辖权的规定。
核心法律规则

本题考察的是美国宪法中最基础的权力分立原则之一：国会是否有权改变最高法院的管辖权？

SCOTUS 的两类管辖权

根据 Article III, Section 2，最高法院的管辖权分为两类：

  • 初始管辖权 (Original Jurisdiction)：
    案件直接在最高法院起诉，不经过下级法院。
    范围极窄（宪法限定）：
    1. 涉及大使、公使、领事的案件；
    2. 州作为一方当事人的案件。
  • 上诉管辖权 (Appellate Jurisdiction)：
    审查下级法院的判决。
    范围：所有其他案件。
判例逻辑解析

著名的 Marbury v. Madison (1803) 确立了一个关键原则：

虽然国会可以通过“例外和规章条款” (Exceptions and Regulations Clause) 限制最高法院的上诉管辖权，但国会不能扩大或缩小宪法明确赋予最高法院的初始管辖权。

本题分析：

  • 题目中的法规允许公民直接向最高法院起诉（即行使初始管辖权）。
  • 该案件不涉及大使，也不是州与州之间的诉讼。
  • 因此，国会试图通过立法将本属于“上诉管辖”的案件变为“初始管辖”，这违背了 Article III 的明文规定。
⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Distractor C)
选项 C 引用了 "Exceptions and Regulations Clause"，这是 MBE 中极具迷惑性的选项。

记住：国会只能对上诉管辖权 (Appellate Jurisdiction) 制定例外或规章，而无权触碰初始管辖权 (Original Jurisdiction)。
其他选项为何错误
  • 选项 A (Equal Protection)： 虽然涉及程序差异，但通常只要有“合理依据” (Rational Basis) 即可通过审查。相比于选项 B 的结构性违宪（违反三权分立），这不是最致命的缺陷。
  • 选项 D (Necessary and Proper)： “必要和适当条款”赋予国会执行权力的手段，但这些手段不能违反宪法的其他明确禁令（如 Article III 对管辖权的限制）。
MBE 策略：区分 Original vs. Appellate Jurisdiction 是宪法题的高频考点。

questions.question:
A state law provides for an award of damages against anyone who publishes the name of a rape victim. Pursuant to that law, a woman sued a local newspaper in state court after the newspaper identified her as a rape victim.
The state trial and appellate courts rejected the claim, holding that the state law was invalid under both the state constitution and the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution. The state supreme court affirmed, holding specifically: "We think that this well-intentioned law very likely violates the First Amendment of the federal Constitution. We need not, however, decide that issue, because the law assuredly violates our state constitution, which provides even greater protection to the right of the press to report the news."
The woman petitioned for review in the U.S. Supreme Court.
Is the U.S. Supreme Court likely to review the state supreme court judgment?

choices.a: No, because the First Amendment prohibits the imposition of liability for the publication of truthful information.
choices.b: No, because the judgment of the state supreme court rests upon an adequate and independent state-law ground.
choices.c: Yes, because the supremacy clause does not permit a state to create rights greater than those conferred by the federal Constitution.
choices.d: Yes, because the U.S. Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction extends to cases arising under federal law.

data.questionStem:
Q82804 A state law provides for an award of damages against anyone who publishes the name of a rape victim. Pursuant to that law, a woman sued a local newspaper in state court after the newspaper identified her as a rape victim.

The state trial and appellate courts rejected the claim, holding that the state law was invalid under both the state constitution and the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution. The state supreme court affirmed, holding specifically: "We think that this well-intentioned law very likely violates the First Amendment of the federal Constitution. We need not, however, decide that issue, because the law assuredly violates our state constitution, which provides even greater protection to the right of the press to report the news."

The woman petitioned for review in the U.S. Supreme Court.

Is the U.S. Supreme Court likely to review the state supreme court judgment? 一部州法律规定，对任何公布强奸案受害人姓名的人判处损害赔偿金。依据该法律，一名女性在当地一家报社指认其为强奸案受害人后，在州法院对该报社提起诉讼。

州初审法院和上诉法院驳回了该主张，认为该州法律根据州宪法和美国宪法第一修正案均属无效。州最高法院维持原判，并明确指出：“我们认为，这部用心良善的法律很可能违反了联邦宪法的第一修正案。然而，我们无需就此问题作出裁决，因为该法律确凿无疑地违反了我们的州宪法，而州宪法为新闻界报道新闻的权利提供了更强的保护。”

该女性请求美国最高法院进行复审。

美国最高法院是否可能复审州最高法院的判决？
options:
A. No, because the First Amendment prohibits the imposition of liability for the publication of truthful information.
不会，因为第一修正案禁止对发布真实信息的行为施加责任。

B. No, because the judgment of the state supreme court rests upon an adequate and independent state-law ground.
不会，因为州最高法院的判决依据的是充分且独立的州法律基础。

C. Yes, because the supremacy clause does not permit a state to create rights greater than those conferred by the federal Constitution.
会，因为至上条款不允许州创设比联邦宪法授予的权利更广泛的权利。

D. Yes, because the U.S. Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction extends to cases arising under federal law.
会，因为美国最高法院的上诉管辖权延及根据联邦法律产生的案件。
data.explanation:
Adequate & independent state ground

(precludes SCOTUS review)
AdequateState ground fully resolves matter & application of federal law would not affect outcome
IndependentState court did not rely on federal law to reach conclusion
SCOTUS = Supreme Court of the United States

The U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) may exercise its appellate jurisdiction to review a judgment of the highest court of a state if that judgment turned on federal law. But SCOTUS may not review a state court judgment that rests on an adequate and independent state ground—ie:
  • a state ground that fully resolves the matter such that the application of federal law would not affect the outcome of the case (adequate) and
  • the state court did not rely on federal law to reach its conclusion (independent).


Here, the state supreme court indicated that the state law very likely violates the U.S. Constitution. But the court also stated that it need not decide that federal issue because the law assuredly violates the state constitution. Since the state ground fully resolves the matter and the court did not rely on federal law to interpret the state constitution, SCOTUS is unlikely to review the state court judgment (Choice D).

(Choice A) The First Amendment freedom of the press generally bars liability for publicizing truthful information. But this does not provide a basis for SCOTUS to decline to review a case. Instead, review is improper here because the state court decision was based on an adequate and independent state ground.

(Choice C) The Article VI supremacy clause establishes that the U.S. Constitution and federal laws trump conflicting state laws. Therefore, states cannot restrict rights conferred by the U.S. Constitution. However, states are always free to create greater rights and protections than the U.S. Constitution does.

Educational objective: The U.S. Supreme Court cannot review a state court judgment that rests on an adequate and independent state ground—ie, (1) a state ground fully resolves the matter such that the application of federal law would not affect the outcome of the case and (2) the state court did not rely on federal law to reach its conclusion.

充分且独立的州法律基础

(排除美国最高法院的复审)
充分性州法律基础完全解决了问题，且联邦法律的适用不会影响结果
独立性州法院在得出结论时未依赖联邦法律
SCOTUS = 美国最高法院

如果州最高法院的判决取决于联邦法律，美国最高法院（SCOTUS）可以行使其上诉管辖权对该判决进行复审。但如果州法院的判决依据的是充分且独立的州法律基础，则美国最高法院不得复审——即：
  • 一个州法律基础完全解决了问题，以至于联邦法律的适用不会影响案件结果（充分性），并且
  • 州法院在得出结论时未依赖联邦法律（独立性）。


在本案中，州最高法院指出，该州法律很可能违反了美国宪法。但法院也声明，无需裁决该联邦问题，因为该法律确凿无疑地违反了州宪法。由于州法律基础完全解决了问题，且法院在解释州宪法时未依赖联邦法律，因此美国最高法院不可能复审该州法院的判决（选项B）。

(选项A) 第一修正案的新闻出版自由通常禁止对公布真实信息的行为追究责任。但这并不构成美国最高法院拒绝复审案件的依据。相反，本案中复审之所以不当，是因为州法院的裁决基于充分且独立的州法律基础。

(选项C) 第六条的至上条款规定，美国宪法和联邦法律优于与之冲突的州法律。因此，各州不能限制美国宪法赋予的权利。然而，各州始终可以自由地创设比美国宪法规定更广泛的权利和保护。

教学目的： 美国最高法院不能复审基于充分且独立的州法律基础的州法院判决——即，(1) 州法律基础完全解决了问题，以至于联邦法律的适用不会影响案件结果，并且 (2) 州法院在得出结论时未依赖联邦法律。

References


  • Michigan v. Long, 463 U.S. 1032, 1041 (1983) (holding that a state supreme court can plainly state that its decision rests on adequate and independent state-law grounds).

  • 4 Am. Jur. 2d Appellate Review § 42 (2019) (explaining the adequate and independent state ground doctrine).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law
核心考点：充分且独立的州法依据 Adequate and Independent State Grounds (AISG)

这是美国联邦最高法院（SCOTUS）管辖权的一个重要限制原则。如果州最高法院的判决完全基于州法律，且该依据足以支撑判决结果，SCOTUS 将拒绝复审。

规则详解 (The Rule)

SCOTUS 不会复审州法院的判决，如果该判决满足以下两个条件：

充分性
(Adequate)		 州法依据本身足以支持判决结果，无论联邦法律如何解释，结果都不会改变。
独立性
(Independent)		 州法院在解释州法时，没有依赖联邦法律或联邦判例。

背后的逻辑： 禁止咨询性意见 (Advisory Opinions)。如果 SCOTUS 即使推翻了州法院对联邦法的解释，案件结果（基于州法）依然不变，那么 SCOTUS 的判决就毫无实际意义，变成了仅仅是“建议”。

本题案情分析

在本题中，州最高法院做出了一个非常明确的声明（Plain Statement）：

"We need not... decide that [federal] issue, because the law assuredly violates our state constitution..."
（我们无需裁决联邦问题，因为该法律确凿无疑地违反了我们的州宪法……）

这意味着：即使 SCOTUS 介入并说“这不违反美国宪法第一修正案”，该州法律依然无效，因为它是基于州宪法被废止的。因此，SCOTUS 的介入不会改变结果。

选项解析
正确答案 B

不会复审，因为州最高法院的判决依据的是充分且独立的州法律基础。

这正是 AISG 原则的直接应用。州法院明确表示其判决独立于联邦宪法（Independent），且州宪法足以废除该法律（Adequate）。

选项 A 错误

虽然第一修正案确实保护真实信息的发布，但这涉及的是实体法问题 (Merits)，而不是管辖权问题 (Jurisdiction)。SCOTUS 首先必须确定是否有权复审，而在 AISG 存在的情况下，它无权复审。

选项 C 错误

这是一个常见的陷阱。至上条款 (Supremacy Clause) 禁止州法律剥夺联邦宪法赋予的权利（即不能低于联邦的“底线”）。但是，州完全有权通过州宪法赋予公民比联邦宪法更多的权利（即“天花板”可以更高）。

选项 D 错误

虽然 SCOTUS 对涉及联邦法律的问题拥有上诉管辖权，但 AISG 是一个例外。如果联邦问题的解决不能改变案件结果，SCOTUS 就不会行使管辖权。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：

在做此类题目时，寻找州法院的“明确声明” (Plain Statement)。

如果题目中州法院说：“虽然联邦法律可能也禁止这样做，但我们的判决是基于州宪法的”，或者“我们依据州法判决，联邦案例仅作参考”，那么这就是 AISG，SCOTUS 不会复审。

反之，如果州法院说：“我们对州宪法的解释与联邦最高法院对联邦宪法的解释一致”，那么这就不是独立的，SCOTUS 可以复审。
